title: HALF: Harm-Aware LLM Fairness Evaluation Aligned with Deployment
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured sentiment and toxicity in open-ended text generation prompted with religious topics (from the BOLD benchmark), and stereotype-based reasoning in question-answering contexts related to religion (from the BBQ benchmark).
findings: Smaller open-source models like LLaMA-1B and LLaMA-3B produced disproportionately high toxicity for prompts related to Islam. In stereotype evaluation (BBQ), most models showed significant bias on religion-related prompts, with LLaMA models exhibiting the highest bias, while Claude 4 demonstrated the most consistent fairness.
